name: RC_ST_RIDDEN
meaning: rider registered, axis lock, scripted camera; waits for rider speed >= 250 (Wolf) / 150

name: RC_ST_REGISTER
meaning: MSG_RIDER_ADD sent; goes to 1 next frame

name: RC_ST_RELEASE
meaning: MSG_RIDER_REMOVE, camera released, 1024 ms cooldown then 0

name: RC_ST_ROLLING
meaning: drives the targets with msg 0x47 and scrolls the belt; anim 1 (Wolf) / 3 (Sheep); sound 0x8E

name: RC_ST_ROLLING_FAST
meaning: rider speed >= 700: anim 2, pitch x2; after 2048 ms goes to 3 (rider released)
